dial.summary: BTC extended its recovery to ~$63.4K on Nov 24 as short liquidations ($74M of $93M total) dominate and perp funding holds low at 0.0038%; real yields declined 9bps on a 4-week basis to ~2.81% (flipping from neutral to supportive), while Global M2 holds at $103.9T and ISM at 55.5% (10th expansion month) reinforce the macro bid — DXY headwind extended to 104.29 (new 19-month high) but BTC.D remains firm near 57% and TOTAL at $2.18T supports continued accumulation ahead of the Dec 1 ISM print and Dec 9 FOMC decision.

indicators.name: Global Liquidity (Global M2)
indicators.note: StreetStats 4-economy basket at $103,884B ($103.9T) as of November 20, 2026; September 2026 G4 confirmed data forms the base; US M2 component at $23.41T in September (Macrotrends, +5.7% YoY); 4-week trend UP (3-month basket growing +0.82% at constant exchange rates per StreetStats); status supportive (4-week trend up, no YoY contraction signal); next confirmation when October G4 aggregates publish.

indicators.name: ISM Manufacturing PMI
indicators.note: October 2026 ISM Manufacturing PMI at 55.5% (released November 2), above consensus 54.6%, up from September's 54.5%; 4-week trend UP (Sep 54.5 → Oct 55.5, +1.0pp); Production sub-index at 59, highest since Nov 2021; Prices Paid 75.2 (from 77.9); status supportive (above 50 and rising, 10th consecutive expansion month); November 2026 data not yet released — next release December 1, 2026.

indicators.name: DXY (US Dollar Index)
indicators.note: ICE DXY at 104.29 on November 24, 2026 per Dealplexus (9:43am IST, day range 104.18–104.32); FXStreet Nov 23 reported DXY bouncing above 103.90 after Eurozone/UK flash PMIs disappointed, extending its bid; Trading Economics Nov 23 close ~103.74; 4-week trend UP — from ~101.7 on October 23 to 104.29 on November 24, net +2.6 points (+2.6%), well above the 0.5% flat threshold; status headwind (ICE DXY 104.29 is above 100 threshold); DXY now near a 19-month high, sustained by resilient US data and disappointing non-US PMIs.

indicators.name: Real Yields (US10Y - CPI)
indicators.note: 10-year TIPS real yield estimated ~2.81% as of November 20, 2026 (StreetStats Nov 20 par yield curve: 10-year 2.81%; vs WatchGold DFII10 2.88% on Nov 19 and BullRunData 2.92% on Nov 18; Nov 19 TIPS auction cleared at 2.903%, secondary yields settled lower at 2.88% then moved to ~2.81% by Nov 20 as 10yr nominal fell from 5.04% to 4.92%); 4-week comparison: Oct 23 ~2.90% → Nov 24 ~2.81% = -9bps, exceeds 5bps flat threshold → trend DOWN; status supportive (falling trend per scoring rules — supporting a shift in the headwind from real yields).

indicators.name: 2s10s Yield Curve
indicators.note: 2s10s spread ~26bps intraday November 23, 2026 (CNBC: 10yr 4.932%, 2yr ~4.69%, ~24–26bps; Benzinga: 10yr 4.95%, 2yr 4.69%, spread ~26bps); official Nov 20 Treasury par yield curve: 10yr 4.92%, 2yr 4.63% = 29bps; 4-week comparison: Oct 23 estimate ~+40bps → Nov 24 ~+26bps = flattened ~14bps over 4 weeks, exceeds 5bps flat threshold → trend DOWN (flattening); curve remains positive (not inverted) but continues to lose steepness; status neutral (positive spread, headwind requires < -50bps inversion, well clear of that threshold).

indicators.name: Fed Balance Sheet
indicators.note: WALCL at $6,741,452M ($6.74T) as of November 18, 2026 per Federal Reserve H.4.1 (Nov 11: $6,758,867M; Nov 4: $6,748,145M; Oct 28: $6,745,635M); 4-week comparison: Oct 28 $6,745,635M → Nov 18 $6,741,452M = -$4.2B = -0.06%, well within flat threshold (<0.5%); next H.4.1 release November 27, 2026 (covering Nov 25 Wednesday); status supportive (QT effectively paused, balance sheet stable — no aggressive tightening signal); American Action Forum confirms $6.7T as of Nov 18, up over $186B YoY.

indicators.name: BTC Funding Rates (perps avg)
indicators.note: CoinGlass OI-weighted BTC funding rate at ~0.0037–0.0040% per 8h as of November 24, 2026 (CoinGlass BTC page: 0.0040%; futures page: 0.0037%; CryptoNRO avg across Binance/Bybit/OKX: +0.0035% — Binance +0.0053%, Bybit +0.0015%, OKX +0.0038%); shorts represent 64.97% of perpetual liquidations ($74M of $93M total 24h), confirming deleveraged structure; BTC at ~$63,443 (+4% from $61K Nov 23); 30-day trend FLAT — rates remain near zero; slightly higher than Oct–early Nov avg but well within normal; status supportive (0.0038% far below 0.04% headwind threshold).

indicators.name: Stablecoin Dominance
indicators.note: Stablecoin market cap ~$281.1B (DefiLlama Nov 24); total crypto market cap ~$2.18T (CoinGabbar/CoinGecko Nov 24 1:30am UTC, BTC dominance ~56.8%); derived stablecoin dominance ~12.9% ($281.1B/$2.18T); 30-day trend UP — from ~10.7% on October 23 (total market ~$2.6T) to ~12.9% now; status neutral (stablecoin dominance rising on 30-day basis but total market cap declining from ~$2.6T → ~$2.18T over same period — headwind requires BOTH rising simultaneously, not met); BTC at ~$63.4K ($281.1B stablecoin vs $2.18T total); note stablecoins fell from $309.7B May 2026 peak (-$28.6B) amid broad deleveraging.

upcoming.title: GDP Q3 2026 — Second Estimate
upcoming.note: BEA releases Q3 2026 GDP second estimate at 8:30 AM ET on the compressed Wednesday pre-Thanksgiving schedule (Nov 26 Thanksgiving); watch consumer spending and PCE deflator revisions for any upside that would reinforce the December 9 FOMC hike case; released same day as October PCE on thin pre-holiday liquidity.

upcoming.title: Durable Goods Orders (October 2026)
upcoming.note: Census Bureau releases October 2026 Advance Durable Goods Orders at 8:30 AM ET on the compressed pre-Thanksgiving Wednesday schedule; orders ex-transportation and ex-defense capital goods (core capex proxy) are the key print; a soft reading would add to the picture of a slowing investment cycle while the Fed weighs December 9 rate action; released same morning as GDP second estimate and PCE.

upcoming.title: PCE Inflation / Personal Income (October 2026)
upcoming.note: BEA releases October 2026 Personal Income and Outlays at 8:30 AM ET; PCE is the Fed's preferred inflation gauge — a hot core reading above +0.3% MoM would reinforce the December 9 FOMC hike case after October CPI surprised at +0.4% MoM; this is the last major inflation print before the November 29 FOMC blackout period starts.

upcoming.title: ISM Manufacturing PMI (November 2026)
upcoming.note: ISM releases November 2026 Manufacturing PMI at 10:00 AM ET (first business day of December); October reading was 55.5 (10th consecutive expansion month); a continuation above 55 would reinforce the late-cycle expansion narrative heading into the December 9 FOMC meeting; Prices Paid sub-index closely watched given elevated input cost pressures in October.

upcoming.title: JOLTS Job Openings (October 2026)
upcoming.note: BLS releases October 2026 JOLTS at 10:00 AM ET; a print above 8M openings would reinforce the tight labor market narrative supporting the December 9 hike case; the quits rate is a leading indicator of wage growth; released 3 days before the November NFP (December 4).
